mapper.sql: SELECT 'PRODUCTION_ORDER'::text AS doc_type, p.id AS doc_id FROM prd_order p WHERE true AND (p.create_by = #{scope.userId} OR p.merch_id = #{scope.userId}) AND p.merch_id = #{ownerId} UNION ALL SELECT 'PURCHASE_ORDER'::text AS doc_type, p.id AS doc_id FROM pur_order p WHERE true AND (p.create_by = #{scope.userId} OR p.buyer_id = #{scope.userId}) AND p.buyer_id = #{ownerId} UNION ALL SELECT 'MRP_CALC'::text AS doc_type, p.id AS doc_id FROM mrp_calc p WHERE true AND p.create_by = #{scope.userId} AND p.create_by = #{ownerId}

SELECT n.doc_type, n.doc_id, MAX(n.create_time) AS latest, COUNT(*) AS notices_total FROM biz_doc_notice n JOIN () visible ON visible.doc_type = n.doc_type AND visible.doc_id = n.doc_id WHERE n.handled_time IS NULL
AND n.doc_type IN #{type}
AND false
GROUP BY n.doc_type, n.doc_id
mapper.select:
SELECT g.doc_type, g.doc_id, g.latest, g.notices_total FROM () g
WHERE (g.latest, g.doc_type, g.doc_id) >< (#{cursorTime}, CAST(#{cursorType} AS text), #{cursorId})
ORDER BY g.latest, g.doc_type, g.doc_id ORDER BY g.latest DESC, g.doc_type DESC, g.doc_id DESC
LIMIT LEAST(GREATEST(#{limit}, 1), 101)

choose.when: SELECT n.* FROM (VALUES (CAST(#{g.docType} AS text), CAST(#{g.docId} AS bigint)) ) g(doc_type, doc_id) JOIN () visible ON visible.doc_type = g.doc_type AND visible.doc_id = g.doc_id JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT dn.* FROM biz_doc_notice dn WHERE dn.doc_type = g.doc_type AND dn.doc_id = g.doc_id AND dn.handled_time IS NULL ORDER BY dn.create_time DESC, dn.id DESC LIMIT LEAST(GREATEST(#{limit}, 1), 100) ) n ON true ORDER BY n.doc_type, n.doc_id, n.create_time DESC, n.id DESC
